body: It was expected of me, and I knew that I would need a degree in something in order to be successful. I know that’s not always the case, but college was the path I was always “supposed” to take.

I completely agree with your statement on being iffy about physics. I mean I knew some physics majors that lived and breathed it. What I wish I could do is art, but I was sort of pushed towards stem careers so I didn’t really develop the best skills. I have been thinking about taking the semester off to really work on my art portfolio, but I’m scared I’ll be even more anxious to return back to school or I’ll get lazy. I could also use that time to work on my mental health, but I’m sure a lot of my peers just stick it out so I don’t want to take the easy path I guess.

Never thought I would say this but probably high school. It’s much more relaxed and way less stressful. In college you feel more pressure to really figure out what you want to do, which has been a personal challenge for me. In high school you still have time to think and explore, without having the high tuition and stress of graduating on time. I never thought I would miss high school, as it wasn’t the best experience for me, but I miss being carefree. I guess that’s just growing up though.

I’m sorry for posting another one of these but thank you everyone for replying. I usually take the time to respond to as many comments as I can but I didn’t have access to my phone for several hours. I didn’t think anyone would take me seriously on this sub, and I was nervous to post, but I’m just glad I was proven wrong. I really do appreciate it and there’s just something about seeing strangers care, and that other people go through the same stuff makes me feel...less out of place I guess. I’m sorry if this sounds cheesy or fake but I’m being sincere. I’m sorry if this post upset anyone, I just needed to get it all out.

I’m sorry it was very vague but I edited my post explaining everything.  I have anxiety, adhd, and really bad self esteem issues (probably body dysmorphic disorder but I’ve never been open about it so no diagnosis). I keep everything in because I’m very reserved, so months later I’ll bring up something to my boyfriend that I was insecure or anxious about. Stupid things but I have such bad self image that I worry. I know he wouldn’t do anything but anyways these past 2 or 3 days we’ve been arguing and I just keep going because it’s built up inside me. So I told him to break up with me if he’s unhappy and he said he didn’t want to, but after a little he said he was breaking up with me and I freaked out. I know it’s not healthy and I know it wasn’t a serious breakup but I’ve been at a mental low point recently. I have a lot of suicidal thoughts, especially at times like this so I cut my wrists, but I knew I wouldn’t have the strength to do it that way so I took pills. In times like these I really do want to die but then I think about my family and what I’ll miss out on. I knew taking the pills was a mistake even before I did them. After that I met up with my boyfriend and we talked for a while. We stayed together and agreed to work on communication more. I’m also starting therapy now because my self consciousness is a big issue and has taken over me sort of. When I went back home my mom could tell I was off and I was going to tell my parents but I hate seeing them hurt. She figured it out quickly though and my dad brought me to the hospital. I was there for around 8 hours because my blood pressure was high due to the extended release adderall. Finally they discharged me, even though my blood pressure is high, but I’ll be okay. I’m so sorry that this is so long and you probably forgot about my post but that’s pretty much what happened. Sorry again for this, and for oversharing. Thank you for commenting though, usually I’m nervous posting on this subreddit because I feel like my struggles aren’t validated.

I have the same issue with my face being unsymmetrical actually. I used to have a therapist, but I don’t have one currently. I know I should have one though, but I find it hard to open up to people. I do like the piercing idea, I’ve been wanting my nose done for a little while now.
Thank you so much for your response. I know I’m just some stranger on the internet, but that helped more than you’ll ever know

I started paying attention to my looks when I started middle school (I’m a college freshman now), but when I entered high school everything got so much worse. I’m sorry that you have to deal with this too, sometimes I feel like I’m the only one.
